title: Neon Tube
body:
"A neon tubing that provides a valuable source of light."

Description

The Neon Tube is a glowing wire that supports logical brightness control.

Instead of a simple on/off state, it responds to numerical logic values:

  • 0 — light is turned off
  • 1–10 — light is turned on, with brightness increasing gradually as the value rises

This allows Neon Tubes to function as a brightness-controlled light source, enabling smooth lighting effects, dimmers, indicators, and automated visual systems when connected to logic components.

You can buy it at Illumine Designs for $450.

The placing system is the same as any other item that depends on some kind of wire.

When placing Neon tubes know that:

  • They cannot be placed on non-solid surfaces.
  • The maximum node count for (1x) box of Neon Tubes is 15 nodes.
